name: pressure-type
title: Pressure Type
description: Each letter of one display word stretches wider and heavier as the cursor nears it, like pressing into rubber.

meta.reducedMotion: Letters stay at the base width and weight.
meta.useWhen: Playful, elastic or physical brands with a variable font that has wdth and wght axes.
meta.avoidWhen: Fonts without variable axes; more than one word; any body copy.
